<canonical_implementation>
```python
def validate_email_structure(email: str):
    if email.count('@') == 1 and email[0] != '@' and (email[-1] != '@'):
        at_index = email.index('@')
        after_at = email[at_index + 1:]
        if '.' in after_at:
            return True
    return False
